steps.content: [Background - Refugee Camp, Overcast]

June 25, N.F. 115
3:41 PM

Vicinity of the Aurum Secretum Institute, Farlands

Inside the refugee camp, armed institute guards brandish their weapons as they herd people toward the central clearing. The only road leading to the research institute is a heavily fortified gauntlet of checkpoints, nearly impassable.
The crowd stirs with restless fear, murmuring among themselves but too terrified to resist.
Then, a scream shatters the silence.
—Ahhh! A monster! A monster's coming!
The cry lands like a detonation, sending shockwaves through the camp. Chaos erupts—shouts, scrambling bodies—and suddenly, a mass of robed refugees, faces hidden, surge toward the guards.

Fear's fragile dam breaks. Panic ignites, and the crowd stampedes toward the institute's entrance, a thrashing tide of bodies. Guards bellow orders, but their voices drown in the frenzy. Within seconds, they're swallowed by the human storm.

steps.speaker: Institute Guard
steps.content: Stop... stop right there! Hands up!
But in the swirling chaos, orders are lost to the wind. The crowd surges forward, unstoppable. The guards exchange grim glances, then the metallic click of rifles being cocked echoes through the air.

steps.speaker: Institute Guard
steps.content: What the hell do you think you're—ugh?!
A dull thwack cuts him off mid-sentence. His body stiffens, then crumples backward like a felled tree. The attacker tosses aside the wooden stick, exhaling sharply.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Hup! Sweet dreams, Mr. Guard.
Thani glances back, just in time to see the other team vanish into the institute's entrance, swallowed by the pandemonium.

Three Hours Ago

Outskirts of Fraser City, Farlands

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: You... drew all this?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Not by myself. Everyone helped!
Hella waves a tree branch, pointing to a circular pattern at the bottom of the sand map.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This is our target—the core laboratory located on the bottom level. The inheritance and Synex should both be there.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We can sneak through the drainage pipes. They'll take us straight from outside the city right into the maze on the first underground level. That way, we dodge the refugees and the guards on the surface.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The maze has always been Synex's turf. She stashed something deep inside, a "contingency plan" that can disrupt the ritual. We've gotta find it fast, and once we do, we go straight to the core area—

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Break Synex's chains and smash the inheritance to pieces!
Horo doesn't answer right away. Instead, she takes the tree branch from Hella's grip before leaning over the map. With deliberate strokes, she circles several junctions connecting the areas.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: The institute won't leave those checkpoints unguarded. You got a plan to handle them?

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: L-leave it to us! We deal with those people every day, so this bit of trouble is nothing new!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yep! Thani and the others will keep the guards busy while we handle things inside the maze!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: And once we hit the core, we'll have Synex backing us up! She'll be a strong ally for sure!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Synex's defense map shows heavy guard presence underground too. At this critical stage, security will be at its peak. Can we really enter the core area in one piece?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: You're overestimating their combat capability.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Once evacuation begins, living personnel will be replaced by Aurum Secretum automatons. You just need to destroy the core receiver to disrupt their command signals and disable them entirely.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I've modified Hella's communicator with a special function. Once destroyed, it will emit a pulse disabling all Aurum Secretum receivers within twenty meters. Use it when necessary.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: As for me...
With a skillful drift, Hypatia steers the sports car onto a different road.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: BR-005 involves more than just the institute. The Campbell family and Fraser Senate stand behind it. If complications arise, they would undoubtedly summon reinforcements.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I'll sever communications between Fraser and the research institute, cutting off their final recourse.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I have one last question.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: What exactly is Synex's "contingency plan"? And how sure are we that it can actually stop the ritual?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Well... honestly I don't really get it either, but...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No plan ever goes perfectly anyway! Didn't Synex say she likes how I stir up trouble? Well, I'll give her a show she won't forget!
Back underground, half the maze's barriers have collapsed since their last visit. Hella and the Legion weave swiftly through the wreckage, making straight for the center.
Performance 1
Performance 2

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: What's... happening? The alchemic beasts are attacking the guards?

Aurum Secretum mechanical guards lie strewn across the ground, smashed aside by the rampaging monsters. The creatures claw open their armored husks, feasting on the glowing Aurum Secretum cores within.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So this is the "contingency plan" she left me? Gotta admit, it's pretty damn clever!
Before she can say more, a deafening roar echoes from the depths of the maze.
Roarrrr—

The ground heaves. From the abyssal dark, a monstrosity of impossible scale erupts. It swings a razor-sharp blade, splintering upon each strike, only to be reforged by Mania. The sheer force rips at the seams of reality.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hella! Is this also a part of her "contingency plan"?!
Despite feeling the ground trembling beneath her feet, Hella breaks into an excited grin.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This big guy definitely wasn't around before! If Synex went through the trouble of unleashing it...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This thing must be it!
